name: tezgah
description: Small plugins for a solo developer's workflow with coding agents: branch guards, a work board, and a procedure for parallel sessions. Each installs alone and adds next to nothing to the context.

plugins.name: bekci
plugins.description: Branch guards as hooks: no direct push to a project's integration or release branch, no edit to a file that has landed and must not change. No skills; nothing enters the context.

plugins.name: pano
plugins.description: A work board for coding sessions: task cards kept in a claude.ai artifact database, outside the conversation, for all of a person's projects.

plugins.name: orkestra
plugins.description: A procedure for running a wave of parallel worker sessions: brief, review, land in order, tidy. Written for the Claude desktop app's Code tab.
